summary: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K on November 3, 2026, attaching its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release (Exhibit 99.1) and earnings presentation (Exhibit 99.2), plus a conference-call notice. Results are routine periodic reporting: quarterly revenue of $231 million (up 40% year over year), net income of $34 million, adjusted EBITDA of $154 million and operating cash flow of roughly $104 million. Nine-month revenue reached $641 million. No transaction, stake, price per share, board recommendation or advisor is stated; the filing is an ordinary earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
